find:
await tx.query("SET LOCAL jit = off");
      const sources = this.attentionSources(actor);
why: Without the policy statement the workspace attention transaction runs with the ambient JIT setting. ATTNJIT-01 samples current_setting('jit') on the same backend before every operation statement and fails where off is required. Needs PostgreSQL 17 (PG_BIN); the mutation CI job installs it.

find:
await tx.query("SET LOCAL jit = off");
      actor.require("tasks.read", projectId);
why: Without the policy statement the project inbox and reviews transactions run with the ambient JIT setting. ATTNJIT-02 observes jit=on inside both project modes. Needs PostgreSQL 17 (PG_BIN).

find:
await tx.query("SET LOCAL jit = off");
      const sources = this.attentionSources(actor);
replace:
await tx.query("SET SESSION jit = off");
      const sources = this.attentionSources(actor);
why: A session-wide setting survives COMMIT on the pooled backend. Every statement inside the transaction still sees off, so only the same-backend read after COMMIT can tell: ATTNJIT-01 observes off after COMMIT where the ambient on is required. A rollback-only assertion would not catch this, because SESSION changes also roll back on failure.

find:
await tx.query("SET LOCAL jit = off");
      actor.require("tasks.read", projectId);
replace:
await tx.query("SET SESSION jit = off");
      actor.require("tasks.read", projectId);
why: Same leak in the project readers: ATTNJIT-02 observes jit off on the same backend after COMMIT where the ambient on is required, in both inbox and reviews modes.
